title: Regional Sales Manager - North
jobDescription:
Responsibilities, role, task & duties of position

· Sales:1. Achievement of model wise, monthly, and annual vehicle wholesale and retail sales target & Targeted market share for his/her region;2. Preparation & execution of annual dealer business plan & get dealer commitment for same 3. Achievement of sales targets in sub verticals of fleet & corporate sales 4. Reduce variability amongst his/her set of dealerships

· Dealer Management:1. Cultivate and manage strong relationship with dealer principals 2. Ensure DP’s commitment & involvement in MG Motor business 3. Track Business growth at dealership and take desired steps to ensure profitability of dealership 4. Ensure achievement of dealer wise business processes & customer satisfaction scores 5. Ensure timely dealer pay-outs for all sales related eligible claims before 15th of month 5. Ensure least gaps in uniform implementation of company policy, strategy and tactical schemes 6. Understand and advise Dealer on Financials

· Field Operations: 1. Guide, lead and mentor the sales field operation teams to achieve the Business objectives 2. Sales process deployment, and standards implementation across network 3. Monitor & improve the processes and standards across network through engagement of network teams 4. Recruitment of qualified and competent resources across network 5. Run desired promotional campaigns as necessary to achieve targeted leads in conjunction with Marketing department 6. High penetration level of BTL implementation in experiential selling to keep brand consideration high 7. Create a highly responsive feedback mechanism; Initiatives; Consumer Finance needs and schemes

· Allied Businesses & Activities:1. Ensure targeted Finance and Insurance penetration at Dealerships 2. Develop and maintain strong relationship with local media, agencies, 3. Develop accessories business as an additional source of revenue stream for dealerships

· Sales Planning, Stock Management & Budget Planning: 1. Three-month advance stock planning input to Plant 2. Management and maintenance of desired level of new car stock at dealers 3. Tactical budget management & running tactical & retail incentive scheme 4. Monitor and control expenses as per approved budget

· Reporting and Payment 1.Maintains Daily, Weekly and Monthly Reports of the sales trends and actions in place (deliveries, bookings),maintain and analyse all records of minutes of meeting and dealer interactions 2.Ensures that the actions decided in the minutes are put into place and follow up the actions 3.Ensures timely payment of all eligible claims of dealership before 10th of subsequent month 4.Escalates unresolved issues at next superior level so that business does not get impacted 5.Makes a complete presentation for each underperforming operational dealers with all issues 6. Collection of funds from dealers for new cars and other ensure no outstanding of company remains 7. Analyse data and trends for his/her region; create information network for lead indicators of Dealer health, market sensing analysis farecasting capabilities



Educational Qualification, experience, skills & knowledge

· BE/MBA with minimum 10+ years’ experience of handling Sales operations in an Auto OEM.

· Excellent spoken and written English, strong & pleasing personality, strong analytical skills, should have handled large teams.

· Persuasive, Strong character & Self Motivated

Competencies & cultural requirements

· Relationship building, Customer Service Orientation

· Team player, coach, mentor and motivator

· Negotiating and Financial skills

· Persuasive

· Strong interpersonal skills, communication skills, drive for results

· Business, industry knowledge leveraging network and business contacts

title: Regional Sales Manager - South (MG Select)
jobDescription:
JD – MG Select Sales

Role Overview

The Zonal Manager – Sales (MG SELECT) is an individual contributor role responsible for driving premium and luxury car sales performance, dealer effectiveness, and customer experience across the assigned zone, in line with MG SELECT’s brand and business objectives.

Position Details

Title: Zonal Manager – Sales, MG SELECT

Grade: Manager / Senior Manager (IC role)

Experience: 10–15 years

Industry: Luxury Automotive (PV four‑wheeler; premium / luxury brands preferred)

Function: Retail Sales / Network Sales

Reporting to: SELECT Sales Head

Base Location: Bangalore (covering South zone / designated MG SELECT markets)

Criticality: Urgent / Priority hire

Key Responsibilities

Deliver retail and wholesale volume, revenue and market share targets for MG SELECT models in the assigned zone, in line with annual business plans.

Drive sell‑out through strong retail activation, lead management, and conversion, working closely with MG SELECT dealerships, sales consultants, and CRM teams.

Ensure strict adherence to all defined MG SELECT dealership SOPs across the sales journey (discovery to delivery), to consistently deliver luxury behaviour and a differentiated, 5‑star customer experience.

Build, mentor and influence front‑line dealership sales teams (DSEs, TLs, ASM‑equivalent) through regular joint field work, coaching and performance reviews, despite being an individual contributor at company payroll.

Ensure MG SELECT brand standards and luxury customer experience benchmarks are met across all touchpoints, including showroom, test drive, delivery, and events.

Track dealer performance on KPIs (retail, enquiry funnel, penetration of finance/insurance/accessories, stock health, ageing, pricing discipline, profit contribution) and drive timely corrective actions.

Lead launch readiness and go‑to‑market execution for new MG SELECT products in the zone, including product, pricing and program communication to dealer teams.

Partner with Marketing and CX teams to conceptualise and execute localised luxury activations, brand experiences and customer engagement events suited to MG SELECT clientele.

Monitor competitive activity (pricing, offers, new launches, retail schemes, influencer and experiential initiatives) and provide structured market intelligence to the central Select team.

Support network development and quality upgradation by sharing inputs on potential MG SELECT locations, dealer capability, and local luxury ecosystem.

Ensure compliance with company policies, sales processes, documentation norms and audit requirements across the assigned dealerships.

Prepare and present periodic performance reviews, dashboards, and action plans to the SELECT Sales Head / SELECT Head, highlighting risks, opportunities and support required.

​

Candidate Profile

10–15 years of experience in passenger vehicle sales, with a strong stint in premium / luxury four‑wheeler brands (e.g., luxury European / global OEMs, premium EVs, or top‑end trims of mainstream OEMs).

Proven track record of managing a multi‑city / zonal portfolio, delivering volume, mix and profitability through dealer partners.

Deep understanding of luxury customer behaviour, HNI/UHNI relationship management and experience‑led selling.

Strong dealer management capability – influencing without direct reporting, conflict resolution, commercial acumen, and joint business planning.

High comfort with performance analytics, sales funnels, CRM tools, and digital retail journeys.

Excellent communication, executive presence, and stakeholder management; able to represent MG SELECT with dealer principals and key customers.

Willingness to travel extensively within the zone and work flexibly around customer and dealer schedules.

Key Competencies

Strategic sales planning & zonal business management

Luxury retail & customer experience orientation

Dealer engagement & influence management

Data‑driven decision‑making and problem solving

Collaboration with cross‑functional teams (Marketing, Network, Finance, CX)

High ownership, agility, and start‑up mindset aligned to MG SELECT’s growth phase.

Role Proposition

This role offers the opportunity to shape MG SELECT’s luxury footprint in a high‑growth region, build strong dealer and customer franchises, and work closely with leadership on scaling a differentiated luxury mobility and experiences brand.
